svg.title: One courtyard, six views of the same visible samples
svg.desc: An original software render produces albedo, world normal, ray depth, roughness, lamp visibility and final direct-lit images for the same camera and geometry.
svg.text: One courtyard, six views of the same visible samples
white is near; d maps over 15 m
white is rough; dark is smooth
Original software render: paving, gate, walls, crate, a block character, and a small lamp.
Logical teaching channels, not Unreal’s packed GBuffer or a capture from Unreal Editor.
